calls.title: Growthbook | AirOps Proposal
calls.summary: The meeting focused on finalizing contract terms and pricing for a flexible annual agreement tailored to new market needs. The team confirmed the Pro plan pricing at $24,000/year with 75,000 tasks per month included, offering unlimited user seats. A discounted rate of $19,000/year was proposed to encourage trial adoption while reducing overage penalties. Integration with Webflow was discussed, emphasizing ease and cost-effectiveness, alongside ongoing improvements to resolve CMS-related issues. The team's approach aims to maximize client satisfaction and set realistic content generation expectations, with a trial focused on output quality rather than speed. Follow-up actions were outlined for feedback on pricing and content needs.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, pricing, trial evaluation, CMS integration, content tasks, discount proposal

calls.title: Growthbook | AirOps Guided Trial
calls.summary: The meeting focused on launching a guided trial aimed at creating SEO-driven content and measuring its early impact on analytics. The trial's objectives include reducing Scott's review workload and validating Air Ops workflows, with a goal of having content ready by April 1st for website indexing. The team discussed connecting Google Analytics and Search Console for effective tracking of content performance, while also identifying technical challenges related to Webflow's handling of rich text. Additionally, Air Ops will be utilized to track competitor content performance, aiding in strategic content planning. Manual engagement is necessary for Reddit, but Air Ops can effectively track brand mentions and citations, informing content gaps and opportunities.
calls.keywords: Air Ops, guided trial, content workflows, SEO, brand kit, Webflow CMS
